description:
Explain why a rejected document was refused and what to change.

get_invoice_submissions has the authority's reply as sent; this
reads it for someone who does not speak SEFAZ: the code, the
message verbatim, what it means, the steps to fix it, the field
at fault and, when there is one, a suggested value. Quote the
code and the message to the user; they are what they will search
for. A suggested value is confirmed with the user before
reissue_invoice, never applied on its own.

transient means the authority was unavailable, not the data
wrong. A document that is not rejected is refused (409).
Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

invoice_id.description: The local id of the rejected invoice, as list_invoices returns it. A rejected document has no access key.

name: explain_rejection

outputSchema.description: Why the authority refused one document, read for a person.

explanation.description: What it means, in plain words.

field.description: The field to fix, when there is one.

status.description: known (from the catalogue of rejection codes), generated (written for this case) or unknown.

suggested.description: A value for that field, when one can be suggested. Confirm it with the user before reissuing.

transient.description: True when the authority was unavailable rather than the data wrong: reissuing unchanged may work.
